## 8. Why this CLA exists

PROJECT JAMES is currently licensed under the MIT License. The Maintainer
intends to keep the Project's mother platform open source. However, the
Maintainer also intends to release domain-specific extensions (e.g.,
hospitality, government, travel packs) under a separate commercial license
from separate repositories, and may, in the future, evaluate alternative
open-source models for the mother platform itself (for example, an
open-core, dual-license, AGPL, or Business Source License model) as the
Project matures.

This CLA grants the Maintainer the rights necessary to make those licensing
decisions without requiring renewed permission from each past Contributor —
a known failure mode for open-source projects that try to relicense after
Contributors are no longer reachable.

By signing, You retain Your full ownership of Your Contribution and may
continue to use it however You wish (including in other projects, open or
closed). The CLA grants the Maintainer additional rights; it does NOT
diminish Your own rights to Your work.

The Maintainer's analytical framework for license decisions is documented
publicly in `docs/strategy/license-and-monetization.md`. That document is
analytical, not binding; final decisions are recorded in
`docs/handovers/v0.2.1-business-track.md` §8 (decision log) when committed.

## 9. Signing

You sign this Agreement by **both** of the following:

**a. Pull request acknowledgment**: Confirming the CLA acknowledgment checkbox
in the pull request template ("I have read `.github/CLA.md` and agree to its
terms for this contribution"), AND

**b. Verifiable identity**: Submitting from a GitHub account that
corresponds to Your real name or organization, OR adding a `Signed-off-by:`
line to Your commit messages with Your real name and email.

The Maintainer treats the combination of (a) and (b) as Your binding
acceptance of this Agreement for the corresponding Contribution.

For Corporate Contributor License Agreement (CCLA) signatures by an entity,
contact the Maintainer via the channel listed in `SECURITY.md` to arrange a
separate written CCLA. Until a CCLA is on file, contributions from
employees-of-record are accepted under the Individual CLA above and the
Contributor warrants they have employer permission per Section 4.a.
